musttry.name: Mas Huni
musttry.description: A traditional Maldivian breakfast made of shredded smoked tuna, coconut, onions, and chili, served with Roshi (flatbread).

musttry.name: Garudhiya
musttry.description: A classic clear fish broth served piping hot with rice, lime, fresh chili, and onion.

musttry.name: Kulhi Boakibaa
musttry.description: A savory, spicy fish cake made with smoked tuna, ground rice, grated coconut, and aromatic Maldivian spices.

musttry.name: Rihaakuru
musttry.description: A thick, dark, and rich fish paste made by slow-cooking tuna for hours. Highly prized for its intense savory flavor.

streetfood.name: Bajiya
streetfood.description: The Maldivian version of a samosa. It features a crispy pastry shell filled with a savory mixture of smoked tuna, grated coconut, onions, and local spices.

streetfood.name: Gulha
streetfood.description: Small, deep-fried pastry balls made from wheat or cassava dough. They are stuffed with a spicy filling of tuna, coconut, lime juice, chilies, and onions.

streetfood.name: Masroshi
streetfood.description: A stuffed flatbread. The dough is filled with a flavorful blend of tuna and coconut spice mix, then cooked on a hot skillet until golden brown.

streetfood.name: Kavaabu
streetfood.description: Savory fish and lentil fritters.Made by blending smoked tuna with ren lentils,ginger,chilies,and aromatic herbs,then shaped into balls or  patties and deep-fried until crisp

drinks.name: Bondi
drinks.description: It is a sweet and refreshing drink consumed from the shell of the coconut, thereby delicious and photogenic as well.

drinks.name: Coconut Milk Smoothies
drinks.description: With rose syrup, water, and even milk or lime added to it at times, this is the perfect drink for a hot afternoon

drinks.name: Dhonkeyokeylu
drinks.description: A sweet, fresh, non-alcoholic or mildly fermented sap tapped directly from the flower stumps of coconut palm trees.

drinks.name: Kurumba
drinks.description: Delicate flower flavor and lighter than red in color have conquered the locals' hearts.

drinks.name: Raa
drinks.description: Enjoy genuine Raa with the locals but responsibly at all times.

drinks.name: Screw Pine Juice
drinks.description: A drink from the fruit tree of the screw-pine, this local beverage has a pungent spicy refreshing taste. It is usually sweetened or tarted up with lime for more pungency.

drinks.name: Rose
drinks.description: A stuffed flatbread. The dough is filled with a flavorful blend of tuna and coconut spice mix, then cooked on a hot skillet until golden brown.

drinks.name: WatarMelon Juice
drinks.description: Fresh pressed watermelon juice is a more recent addition, and enjoyed all over the islands.

seafood.title: Grilled Yellowfin Tuna Steaks
seafood.description: Freshly marinated tuna steak grilled over charcoal.

seafood.title: Maldivian Lobster Specials
seafood.description: Exquisite reef lobster served with garlic butter.

seafood.title: Reef Fish Barbeques
seafood.description: Red Snapper and Grouper marinated in local spices.

seafood.title: Garlic Butter Prawns
seafood.description: Fresh prawns seared in rich garlic and soy butter.

seafood.title: Mas Riha
seafood.description: AA traditional Maldivian fish curry made with fresh tuna, aromatic spices, and creamy coconut milk

seafood.title: Smoky Octopus Delicacies
seafood.description: Tender octopus tentacles charred with chili paste.

diningHero.subtitle: Taste Maldives with Confidence
diningHero.title: Vegetarian & Halal Dining Guide
diningHero.description: Discover delicious vegetarian and halal-friendly dining experiences across the Maldives, from authentic local flavors to fresh island cuisine and international favorites.

expectations.title: Wide Vegetarian Choices
expectations.description: From traditional Maldivian dishes to global cuisines, find plenty of tasty vegetarian options.

expectations.title: Halal Assurance
expectations.description: Enjoy peace of mind with halal certified restaurants and kitchens across the islands.

expectations.title: Diverse Cuisines
expectations.description: Savor Indian, Middle Eastern, Asian and Continental dishes prepared with authentic flavors.

expectations.title: Resort & Local Dining
expectations.description: Whether at luxury resorts or local cafes, delicious halal and vegetarian meals are within reach.

diningSpots.name: Seagull Café House
diningSpots.description: A cozy spot offering delicious vegetarian and vegan meals in a relaxed environment.

diningSpots.name: Sala Thai Restaurant
diningSpots.description: Halal certified Thai cuisine with a variety of vegetarian dishes.

diningSpots.name: Sunset Lounge
diningSpots.description: Enjoy vegetarian friendly meals with stunning ocean views.

diningSpots.name: The Olive Cafe
diningSpots.description: Halal friendly café offering fresh salads, mezzes and vegetarian delights.

foodCards.title: Local Maldivian Flavors
foodCards.description: Taste authentic island flavors featuring fresh seafood, coconut, rice, spices, and locally inspired recipes.

foodCards.title: Fresh & Tropical
foodCards.description: Enjoy fresh coconuts, tropical fruits, refreshing juices, and locally sourced ingredients throughout your island stay.

foodCards.title: Vegetarian & Halal Choices
foodCards.description: From vegetarian dishes to halal-friendly dining, Maldives offers plenty of options for every preference.

tips.title: Check Ingredients
tips.description: If you have dietary restrictions, ask the restaurant about ingredients and preparation.

tips.title: Look for Halal Options
tips.description: Choose restaurants or resorts that clearly offer halal-friendly dining.

tips.title: Try Local Food
tips.description: Don't miss traditional Maldivian flavors such as coconut-based curries, rice dishes, and local snacks.

tips.title: Stay Hydrated
tips.description: The tropical climate can be warm, so keep water with you throughout the day.
